title: WoDX Atmosphere
description: World of Darkness Expanded: the weather and the era kits. Each night's weather comes from the chronicle's seed, the climate and the date, with the era's climate (the Little Ice Age, 1816, a warmer future): it sets the sky for sunlight, puts rain, snow or fog on outdoor scenes, tells the Storyteller what it does to rolls, and feeds WoDX Senses. Scenes can take their darkness from the sun and moon. Each era kit adds music moods as playlists, ambience for the kind of place and the weather, short cues at dawn and sunset, a light colour grade on the map, and handouts in the era's style. Token frames in the era's material (iron, gilt, brass, chrome, neon) go round the players' characters. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
